title: Fix the Todo Manager's Broken Lookup
description: The program should mark a todo item as complete by matching its task name. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print True — the task should be found and marked complete by its text, regardless of how that text string was constructed.
actualProblem: todo.task is task_name checks whether the two variables refer to the exact same string object in memory (identity), not whether their text is equal. Rebuilding the text at runtime with " ".join([...]) creates a brand-new string object with the same characters as "Buy milk", but it is not the same object Python stored earlier, so the identity check silently fails.
explanation: is compares object identity, while == compares value equality. Two strings with identical text are not guaranteed to be the same object in memory, so comparing text with is is unreliable — value comparisons should always use ==.
